scripts.lint: oxlint -c tooling/oxc/base.json core adapters packages tooling --deny-warnings
scripts.format: oxfmt -c tooling/oxc/oxfmt.json --write core adapters packages tooling '!**/.cache/**' '!**/dist/**' '!**/*.d.ts' '!**/*.tsbuildinfo'
scripts.format:check: oxfmt -c tooling/oxc/oxfmt.json --check core adapters packages tooling '!**/.cache/**' '!**/dist/**' '!**/*.d.ts' '!**/*.tsbuildinfo'
scripts.check:static: bun run check:declarative-errors && bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.check: bun run check:static && nx run-many -t typecheck test && bun run check:dts-warnings
scripts.publish:npm: bun run check && bun run publint && bun run release:publish
scripts.publish:npm:dry: bun run check && bun run publint && nx release publish --dry-run
